lines.en: label mikuspring3:
scene mikugymtalk1
: Alright, ladies! Listen up!
lines.zh: 好了，姑娘们！听好了！

lines.en: : I know y’all look at me like some kinda loser that knowns nothin’ ‘bout anythin’, but I’m here today to tell ya that I {i}do{/i} know somethin’! And that somethin’ is sports!
lines.zh: 我知道你们都把我当成一个啥也不懂的废物，可我今天就是要告诉你们：我{i}确实{/i}懂点东西！而那样东西就是体育！

lines.en: : Apologies for interrupting, but I don’t think any of us need reminding that your expertise lies in-
lines.zh: 抱歉打断一下，不过我觉得我们都不需要被提醒你的专长在——

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk2
: Personal foul — roughing the speaker! Number six! Fifteen-yard penalty! First down, Miku!
lines.zh: 个人犯规——撞击发言者！六号！罚十五码！首攻，Miku！

lines.en: : ...What?
lines.zh: ……什么？

lines.en: : It means shut the heck up while I’m tryin’ to give my motivational speech! I don’t care if ‘yer my roommate or not! I got trainin’ to do!
lines.zh: 意思就是我在发表动员演讲的时候你给我闭嘴！我管你是不是我室友！我还要训练呢！

lines.en: : Just let her continue, Makoto. We all showed up because we trust Miku to lead us to victory in this year's sports-day-slash-dorm-wars contest.
lines.zh: 让她说完吧，Makoto。我们之所以都来了，是因为我们相信 Miku 能带我们在今年的「运动会兼宿舍大战」里夺冠。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk3
: The full title is actually: Super Mega Ultimate Sports-Day Dorm Wars: No Boys Allowed ~ The Extremely Awesome and Only Kind of Sad Special Event for Bonding and Battling.
lines.zh: 完整标题其实是：《超级无敌终极运动会宿舍大战：男生禁止入内～超厉害、但也有点可悲的增进感情与较量特别活动》。

lines.en: : Was the “No Boys Allowed” part really necessary to add? Because I really don’t think Sensei was planning on showing up this year even {i}if{/i} he were invited.
lines.zh: 「男生禁止入内」那部分真的有必要加吗？因为我真不觉得 Sensei 今年打算露面，{i}就算{/i}请他也不来。

lines.en: : I think that’s...why we added the “kind of sad” part...but I agree that...we should make the title a little shorter...
lines.zh: 我想……正因为这样我们才加了「有点可悲」那部分……不过我也同意……标题该短一点……

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk4
: The title ain’t important right now! All that matters is preparin’ for the SMUS-DDW:NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB so we ain’t blindsided by any plannin’ those second floor gals are doin’!
lines.zh: 标题现在不重要！重要的是为 SMUS-DDW:NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB 做准备，这样我们就不会被二楼那些丫头的计划打个措手不及！

lines.en: : Is it just me or does the acronym make it even harder to remember?
lines.zh: 是我一个人这么想，还是这个缩写反而更难记了？

lines.en: : It’s just you. I can remember SMUS-DDW:NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB just fine.
lines.zh: 就是你一个人。我记 SMUS-DDW:NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB 记得可清楚了。

lines.en: : Thank you, Ayane! But again, the name ain’t important right now!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，Ayane！不过再说一遍，名字现在不重要！

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk5
: The unfortunate truth is we’ve always had an advantage when it comes to these Dorm Wars thingies since ours is the floor that loves Sensei the most!
lines.zh: 不幸的事实是，以往这种宿舍大战我们一直占优势，因为我们这层楼最爱 Sensei！

lines.en: : Now that he’s stripped outta the competition entirely, we’ve gotta figure out a way to compensate! And that ain’t gonna be easy when they’ve got girls like Touka and Noriko up there!
lines.zh: 现在他彻底退出竞争了，我们得想个办法补上！而他们楼上还有 Touka 和 Noriko 这样的女生，这事可不轻松！

lines.en: : Are either of those two athletic? Because I’ve never seen either one of them do anything to prove that at any point.
lines.zh: 那两个人有运动细胞吗？我可从没见过她们任何一个做过什么能证明这一点的事。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk6

: Touka’s always talkin’ about how she wants to show us her skills when it comes to that stuff. And if there’s anythin’ I know about vegans like Noriko, it’s that they’ve got super powers and can fly and stuff.
lines.zh: Touka 老说想让我们见识她这方面的本事。至于 Noriko 那种纯素食者，我唯一知道的就是她们有超能力、会飞什么的。

lines.en: : Noriko’s a vegetarian, actually. She’s not vegan.
lines.zh: Noriko 其实是素食者，不是纯素食者。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk7
: Damn. So she probably just has super-speed instead.
lines.zh: 操。那她大概只是有超级速度而已。

lines.en: : If anything, I think Tsuneyo is the one we’re going to have to worry about. She’s kind of...comically strong.
lines.zh: 要说的话，我觉得该担心的是 Tsuneyo。她有点……强得离谱。

lines.en: : Doesn’t...Kirin have experience with sports too?...
lines.zh: Kirin……不是也有运动经验吗？……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be surprised if dorm seven was above-average in that field as well. Uta’s great when it comes to archery and I’m pretty sure Io is into baseball.
lines.zh: 七号宿舍在这块高于平均我也不意外。Uta 射箭很厉害，而且我挺确定 Io 喜欢棒球。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk8
: And all that’s exactly why we’ve gotta practice!
lines.zh: 所以这正是我们必须练习的原因！

lines.en: : We’ve still got no clue what sortsa contests we’ll be havin’ and what kinda games we’ll be playin’, so we’ve gotta prepare for anythin’ and everythin’ so we can have strategies in place and not look bad!
lines.zh: 我们完全不知道会有什么比赛、玩什么游戏，所以我们得为一切可能做好准备，这样才有策略、才不会出丑！

lines.en: : I’m surprised to see your competitive spirit this ignited, Miku. Normally, that’s my thing. And we don’t even know this year’s prize yet, so there’s no way {i}that’s{/i} what lit this fire.
lines.zh: 我真意外你的好胜心能烧得这么旺，Miku。平时这可是我的活儿。而且我们连今年的奖品都还不知道，所以{i}那{/i}肯定不是点燃这把火的原因。

lines.en: : It ain’t the prize that matters, Makoto. It’s the glory of the braggin’ rights. And I ain’t just sayin’ that since only like one instance of the Dorm Wars has actually had a real prize.
lines.zh: 重要的不是奖品，Makoto。是吹牛的资格带来的荣耀。而且我才不是因为宿舍大战里只有那么一次真的有奖品才这么说的。

lines.en: : Shh...I thought we agreed that we were going to stop bringing that up?
lines.zh: 嘘……我们不是说好不再提那件事了吗？

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk9
: We are! So instead of focusin’ on the past, let’s start figurin’ out where to go in the future!
lines.zh: 是没提啊！所以与其纠结过去，不如开始想想以后往哪走！

lines.en: : Futaba! Tell me some of ‘yer strengths!
lines.zh: Futaba！说说你有什么强项！

lines.en: : Me?
lines.zh: 我？

lines.en: : Yes, you! There’s gotta be somethin’ you’re good at when it comes to sports!
lines.zh: 对，就是你！体育方面你总有擅长的吧！

lines.en: : Can I pass? I’ve never really been an {i}athletic{/i} person.
lines.zh: 我能弃权吗？我从来就不是个{i}擅长运动{/i}的人。

lines.en: : Part’a bein’ an athlete is mental too! Just think’a baseball! That game’s like 90%% mental and 5%% physical, with the other 10%% bein’ luck!
lines.zh: 当运动员也靠脑子！想想棒球！那运动 90%% 靠脑子、5%% 靠身体，剩下 10%% 靠运气！

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk10
: Five...ten...
: Then...I guess...I’m okay when it comes to problem-solving? Maybe? So long as the problem...isn’t about me...I think...
lines.zh: 那么……我大概……解决问题还可以？也许吧？只要那个问题……不是关于我的……我想……

lines.en: : Like, I don’t want to say I’m {i}creative,{/i} but-
lines.zh: 就是，我不想说自己{i}有创意{/i}，不过——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah, yeah! Good enough!
lines.zh: 行行行！够用了！

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk11
: If you’re good at problem solving, you might make a good coach! And you like reading, don’t ya?! Which means ya could get familiar with the rules of stuff super quick! Maybe!
lines.zh: 既然你擅长解决问题，说不定能当个好教练！而且你喜欢看书，对吧？！那意味着你能超快地熟悉各种规则！也许吧！

lines.en: : So, since we ain’t got any idea what we’ll be playin’ yet, why don’t ya head on over to the library after our meeting today and take out a book on every sport ever?! That’ll be sure to give us an advantage.
lines.zh: 所以，既然我们还不知道要比什么，你不如今天散会后去图书馆，把讲每项运动的书都借一遍？！那肯定能让我们占优势。

lines.en: : E...Every sport?....
lines.zh: 每……每项运动？……

lines.en: : I don’t think Miku understands how quickly the average person reads, Futaba. I’ll help you look for relevant materials once we’re done here.
lines.zh: 我觉得 Miku 不懂普通人看书有多快，Futaba。等这边结束我帮你找相关资料。

lines.en: : Sana! You next! What are you good at?
lines.zh: Sana！下一个！你擅长什么？

lines.en: : No need to answer! I already know you’re gonna say video games! Which means your hand-eye coordination is probably better than a lot of the other girls!
lines.zh: 不用回答！我已经知道你要说电子游戏了！那意味着你的手眼协调大概比其他很多女生都强！

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk12
: I...I mean...um...maybe? But I...get tired really easily and...
lines.zh: 我……我是说……嗯……也许吧？可是我……特别容易累，而且……

lines.en: : Drink a Monster! Maybe two! Do whatever ya gotta do to amp those energy levels up, cause you’ll be our secret weapon once sports day rolls around! Got it?!
lines.zh: 喝魔爪！来两罐也行！为了把能量提上去什么招都使出来，因为运动会一到，你就是我们的秘密武器！明白吗？！

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk13
: N-No?!?! Why do I have to be the secret weapon?! I couldn’t even answer my own question!
lines.zh: 不、不要？！？！为什么我得当秘密武器？！我连自己的问题都答不上来！

lines.en: : Maybe we’ll get lucky and there will be some sort of...video-game based competition?
lines.zh: 也许我们运气好，会有某种……基于电子游戏的比赛？

lines.en: : For {i}sports day?!{/i} I doubt it, coach! We’ve gotta prepare for a full day’s worth of sweatin’ and...well, sports! And anythin’ else that starts with an S! Spaghetti maybe?
lines.zh: 在{i}运动会{/i}上？！我可不敢指望，教练！我们得为一整天的出汗……嗯，还有运动做准备！以及任何以 S 开头的东西！也许意面？

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk14
: What about me, Miku? I’m good at all sorts of stuff.
lines.zh: 那我呢，Miku？我什么都会一点。

lines.en: : Which means you’ll be our ringer! Same as me. And if we’re able to compete in more than one thing, me and you’ll be the ones to make the second floor’s life a living hell. Understood?!
lines.zh: 那你就当我们的王牌！跟我一样。要是能参加不止一项，我和你就是让二楼那帮人生不如死的人。明白了吗？！

lines.en: : Got it! But also, please reconsider making Sana the secret weapon. I really don’t think she’s built for things like this.
lines.zh: 明白！不过还是请你重新考虑一下让 Sana 当秘密武器这事。我真觉得她不是干这个的料。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk15
: I ain’t reconsiderin’ nothin’, Ayane! This ain’t ‘yer grandma’s sports-day! This is the contest to end all contests! And by George, we’re gonna win this one for the boys back home!
lines.zh: 我什么都不会重新考虑，Ayane！这可不是你奶奶那辈的运动会！这是终结一切比赛的比赛！老天作证，我们要为了家乡的男孩们把这场赢下来！

lines.en: : As much as I agree, I thought your whole thing was that sports are great for reasons {i}outside{/i} of the winning part?
lines.zh: 虽然我同意，可你不是一直说体育的好处在于{i}输赢之外{/i}的东西吗？

lines.en: : That was before the boys came back home, Makoto! Now, we’ve gotta win this for them!
lines.zh: 那是男孩们回家之前的事了，Makoto！现在，我们得为了他们赢下这场！

lines.en: : What boys? All the boys are still in space. Apart from my dad, at least.
lines.zh: 什么男孩？所有男孩都还在太空上呢。至少除了我爸。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk16
: You know...the boys! The ones back home!
lines.zh: 你知道的……那些男孩！家乡的那些！

lines.en: : The boys on the docks! The boys are back in town! You know! {i}The boys!{/i}
lines.zh: 码头上的男孩们！男孩们回城了！你知道的！{i}那些男孩！{/i}

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk15
: Forget Makoto! The point is, we’ve all got a role to play!
lines.zh: 别管 Makoto！重点是，我们每个人都有角色要演！

lines.en: : Tom Brady says that the {i}true{/i} competitors are the ones who always play to win. And the last thing we need is those people livin’ above us thinkin’ they’re higher up the ladder than we are!
lines.zh: Tom Brady 说过，{i}真正的{/i}竞争者永远是为了赢而战。而我们最不需要的，就是楼上那帮人以为自己比我们高人一等！

lines.en: : That’s- oh, it’s not even worth it.
lines.zh: 那是——唉，不值得纠正。

lines.en: : You’ve got that right, boobzilla! Now, everybody stand up tall and pay attention while I give ya the rundown of every single sport we might be playin’ for sports-day! You too, Sana!
lines.zh: 说得太对了，波霸zilla！好了，全体站直了认真听，我要给你们过一遍运动会可能比的每一项运动！你也是，Sana！

lines.en: : Huh?...What?...Where am I?...
lines.zh: 哈？……什么？……我这是在哪？……

lines.en: : The first sport we’re gonna talk about is curling. Ya see, it all starts with a broom-
lines.zh: 我们要讲的第一项运动是冰壶。你看，一切都要从一把扫帚开始——

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk17
: Okay. Hit the showers, everybody. And thank you for being the ones who actually showed up. Futaba, you can have a head start so Miku can’t prey upon you again.
lines.zh: 好了。大家去洗澡吧。谢谢你们这几位真的来了。Futaba，你可以先走一步，免得 Miku 又盯上你。

lines.en: : Hey! That’s a deleted scene now, damn it! And don’t go puttin’ an end to my meeting without askin’ me first!
lines.zh: 喂！那段现在算删减片段了，该死！还有，别不打招呼就宣布我的会议结束！

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk18
: Then, would {i}you{/i} like to do the honors? Because class is already done for the day and you told everyone this would only take ten minutes.
lines.zh: 那么，{i}你{/i}想来宣布吗？因为今天的课已经结束了，而且你跟大家说这只要十分钟。

lines.en: : Ten minutes...ten hours...what’s the difference?
lines.zh: 十分钟……十小时……有什么区别？

lines.en: : That would be 590 minutes.
lines.zh: 那是 590 分钟。

lines.en: : You think you’re so damn smart, don’t ya?
lines.zh: 你觉得自己挺聪明的，是吧？

lines.en: : Do you want the honors or not? Because we can’t keep them here all day.
lines.zh: 你到底要不要来宣布？因为我们不能把她们留一整天。

lines.en: : As a matter of fact, I {i}would.{/i} Thank you.
lines.zh: 事实上，我{i}愿意{/i}。谢谢。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk19
: Let this be a lesson to all of ya! If ‘yer gonna give a speech, make sure ya don’t bring Makoto along to listen to it!
lines.zh: 你们都给我记着这个教训！要是你们要发表演讲，千万别带 Makoto 来听！

lines.en: : Meeting adjourned! But don’t forget we’ve got another-
lines.zh: 散会！不过别忘了我们还有——

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk20
: Heh?
lines.zh: 哎？

lines.en: : The heck you tryin’ to hold my hand for? We both like boys.
lines.zh: 你他妈拉我手干嘛？我们俩都喜欢男的。

lines.en: : Miku, you have phonophobia. Do you really think I’m going to let you blow a whistle and send yourself into shock?
lines.zh: Miku，你有恐声症。你真觉得我会让你吹哨子把自己吓休克？

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk21
: Oh, right. Good call.
lines.zh: 哦，对。有道理。

lines.en: scene black
: Anyway! Hit the showers, girls! Me and Makoto’ll be there once we clean up our balls!
lines.zh: 总之！姑娘们，去洗澡吧！我和 Makoto 把我们的球收拾干净就过去！

lines.en: : She means our sports balls.
lines.zh: 她说的是我们的运动用球。

lines.en: : We’ll support you no matter what kind of balls you have, Makoto.
lines.zh: 不管你有什么样的球，我们都支持你，Makoto。

lines.en: : Why do I feel like I’ve had this conversation before?
lines.zh: 我怎么觉得这段对话以前聊过？

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk22
: So...you’re really into the Dorm Wars this year, aren’t you?
lines.zh: 这么说来……你今年真的很投入宿舍大战啊？

lines.en: : Huh? Course I am. We’re combinin’ two of my favorite things — sports and war. Just kinda sucks that Sensei won’t be involved this time.
lines.zh: 哈？当然了。这可是把我最爱的两样东西合在了一起——体育和战争。只是这次 Sensei 不参加，有点可惜。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk23
: I’m sure he’ll be back next year. Or the year after. There’s only so much time he can spend moping around now that life is a constantly repeating-
lines.zh: 我相信他明年就会回来。或者后年。既然生活现在在不停地重复，他能消沉的时间也就那么多——

lines.en: : Wonder what he’s up to right now? Haven’t seen him since karaoke the other night.
lines.zh: 不知道他这会儿在干嘛？那天晚上唱完卡拉 OK 之后就没见过他了。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk24
: Karaoke?
lines.zh: 卡拉 OK？

lines.en: : Yeah. Remember when I-
lines.zh: 对啊。还记得我那次——

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk25
: Oh god, I just remembered what happened right before that.
lines.zh: 天啊，我刚想起在那之前发生了什么。

lines.en: : Shhh...no you don’t. That was all in your head, Miku. You never saw anything at all. And if you did, it definitely wasn’t me you saw doing it. Now, what’s this about karaoke?
lines.zh: 嘘……你什么都没想起。那都是你脑补的，Miku。你什么都没看见。就算看见了，你看到的也绝对不是我。好了，卡拉 OK 是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk26
: Oh, sorry. Me and Sensei bumped into Karin when we were walkin’ around and the three of us wound up goin’ to that karaoke place near the school.
lines.zh: 哦，抱歉。我和 Sensei 逛着逛着撞见了 Karin，然后我们三个就去了学校附近那家卡拉 OK。

lines.en: : Since when are you into karaoke? You haven’t expressed any interest in that for as long as I’ve known you.
lines.zh: 你什么时候开始喜欢卡拉 OK 了？我认识你这么久，你可从没表现出过兴趣。

lines.en: : Iduno, figured I’d try somethin’ new for once. Didn’t amount to much though since I forgot I already made plans with Io and Uta and had to bail before even tryin’ to sing a song.
lines.zh: 不知道，想着偶尔试试新鲜事物呗。不过也没什么结果，因为我忘了自己已经跟 Io 和 Uta 有约，歌还没唱就得先撤了。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk27
: Huh...
: Somethin’ felt kinda off, though. Sensei started bein’ weird as soon as I brought up the idea. Didn’t realize he was that self-conscious.
lines.zh: 不过感觉有点怪。我一提这个主意，Sensei 就开始不对劲了。没想到他那么在意别人的眼光。
我……明白了……

lines.en: : Guess I don’t know as much about him as you, though. For all I know, you two have been knockin’ boots in that same place for the past-
lines.zh: 不过我对他的了解大概没你多。说不定你们俩早就在那地方搞上了，过去这——

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk28
: Wait! That’s it, ain’t it! He felt weird ‘cause I was bringin’ him to-
lines.zh: 等等！就是这个，对吧！他觉得怪，是因为我把他带到了——

lines.en: : Shh. Keep your voice down.
lines.zh: 嘘。小声点。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk29
: He felt weird ‘cause I was bringin’ him to your secret sex lounge and he ain’t done that with me and Karin yet.
lines.zh: 他觉得怪，是因为我把他带到了你那个秘密性爱包厢，而他还没跟我和 Karin 在那儿做过。

lines.en: : Uhh...no. I don’t think that’s it. I’ve only been there with him on one occasion and I can promise you it was definitely not sexual. Just weird.
lines.zh: 呃……不是。我觉得不是这个原因。我和他只去过那里一次，而且我可以保证那绝对跟性无关。就是挺怪的。

lines.en: : Picturin’ you two singin’ together is definitely weird, so yeah. I can see that.
lines.zh: 想象你们俩一起唱歌确实挺怪的，所以嘛。我能理解。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk30
: No, I just mean there might be {i}other{/i} reasons why he’s...uncomfortable there. It just doesn’t make much sense to me yet, so I’m not sure if I can explain it well enough for you to understand.
lines.zh: 不是，我只是说他在那儿不自在，可能还有{i}别的{/i}原因。只是我还没想通，所以不确定能不能讲得让你明白。

lines.en: : But regardless, I’m sure he’ll get over his hump sure enough.
lines.zh: 不过不管怎样，我相信他迟早能跨过那道坎。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk31
: Well, that’s good. ‘Cause I know we’ve got some humpin’ we wanna do as well.
lines.zh: 嗯，那就好。因为我知道我们也有「那方面」的事要做。

lines.en: : I really don’t like this openly sexual side of you. You’re starting to remind me of my mom.
lines.zh: 我真不喜欢你这么露骨的一面。你开始让我想起我妈了。

lines.en: : Ain’t nothin’ wrong with that. Maki’s great. And thanks to her, I aint back-alley medicated no more. Plus, I’m learnin’ to actually talk about stuff, too. And you’ve wanted me to do that forever.
lines.zh: 那有什么不好。Maki 很棒。多亏了她，我再也不用吃后巷弄来的药了。而且我也在学着真的把话说出来。这不是你一直希望的吗。

lines.en: : How’s that going, by the way? We haven’t really talked about it lately.
lines.zh: 对了，这事进展怎么样？我们最近都没怎么聊过。

lines.en: : Fine, I guess. Haven’t really gotten to the tough parts yet. But you said it took a little while for you to get there too, didn’t it?
lines.zh: 还行吧。还没真正碰到最难的部分。不过你说过你也花了点时间才到那一步，对吧？

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk32
: It did, yeah...but I’m also a lot more open as a person than you’ve ever been.
lines.zh: 是啊，花了……不过我这个人本来就比你开朗得多。

lines.en: : Are ya? Cause apart from this one thing, I sure don’t think so. You’ve been keepin’ your sadness a secret for as long as I’ve known ya.
lines.zh: 是吗？除了这一件事，我可不这么觉得。从我认识你起，你就一直把自己的难过藏着掖着。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk33
: I’m glad, though. Cause lately, you’ve felt a lot...different. Happier, maybe?
lines.zh: 不过我挺高兴的。因为最近你给人的感觉……很不一样。也许更开心了？

lines.en: : I don’t really know. Maybe I’m wrong and ya ain’t happy at all. But, at the very least, I’m glad we’re both gettin’ help now. If we waited any longer, we might’a ended up like Sensei.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。也许我猜错了，你一点都不开心。不过至少，我很高兴我们俩现在都在接受帮助。要是再拖下去，我们可能就会变成 Sensei 那样。

lines.en: : And I don’t know about you, Makoto, but I ain’t all that interested in a world where Ami needs to wipe drool off of my chin.
lines.zh: 我不知道你怎么想，Makoto，反正我对一个需要 Ami 替我擦口水的世界可一点兴趣都没有。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk34
: I see...
lines.zh: 这样啊……

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: 我是开心的。

lines.en: : Happier now, I mean.
lines.zh: 我是说，现在更开心了。

lines.en: : Or...at least, more {i}free.{/i}
lines.zh: 或者……至少，更{i}自由{/i}了。

lines.en: : It’s kind of crazy, actually. Like all of the weight I’ve been carrying my whole life has somehow just {i}vanished.{/i} And I can be me {i}now{/i} without worrying about how I’ll be in the {i}future.{/i}
lines.zh: 其实挺疯狂的。就像我这辈子一直扛着的重量，不知怎么就{i}消失{/i}了。我可以{i}现在{/i}做我自己，而不用担心{i}未来{/i}的我会变成什么样。

lines.en: : Ain’t that kinda dangerous, though? You’ve always been worried about the future. ‘Bout where you’ll “end up” and stuff like that.
lines.zh: 不过这样不危险吗？你以前一直都在担心未来。担心自己会「落到什么下场」之类的。

lines.en: : And, now that I’m not, I can finally breathe.
lines.zh: 而现在我不担心了，我终于能喘口气了。

lines.en: : I get it, I think. Just don’t want ya losin’ sight of all that and endin’ up in a place you never wanted.
lines.zh: 我大概懂。只是不想你因此丢了方向，最后落到你从未想过的地方。

lines.en: scene mikugymtalk35
: Your situation’s different than somethin’ like that happenin’ to somebody like me who’s never really {i}had{/i} a place they’ve wanted to go. You’ve got more to lose.
lines.zh: 你的处境，跟像我这样从来没{i}有过{/i}想去的地方的人不一样。你能失去的更多。

lines.en: : But hey, if ‘yer happy...’yer happy. And I ain’t gonna tell ya how to live your life. Just wanted to know everythin’s okay.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，你要是开心……那就是开心。我也不会对你的人生指手画脚。我只是想知道一切都没事。

lines.en: : Yeah...thanks.
lines.zh: 嗯……谢谢。

lines.en: : Can I...ask you something, Makoto?
lines.zh: 我能……问你件事吗，Makoto？

lines.en: : Of course. Unless it’s about what you saw at the porn shop.
lines.zh: 当然。除非是问你在色情商店看到了什么。

lines.en: : It’s just...
lines.zh: 只是……

lines.en: : Are you really okay with Sensei not bein’ back yet? It really ain’t botherin’ you?
lines.zh: Sensei 还没回来，你真的无所谓吗？真的不介意？

lines.en: : Of course it bothers me, Miku.
lines.zh: 我当然介意啊，Miku。

lines.en: scene black
: There’s just...no rush anymore.
lines.zh: 只是……已经不着急了。

lines.en: : Better be careful, then. Not rushin’ means that somebody else might beat you to the punch.
lines.zh: 那你最好小心点。不着急，就意味着别人可能先你一步。

lines.en: : If that person’s me, we’ll stay friends...won’t we?
lines.zh: 如果那个人是我，我们还是朋友吧……对吧？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: 当然。

lines.en: : That’s good...
lines.zh: 那就好……

lines.en: : Cause I’ve been learnin’ more about threesomes lately and, I’ve gotta say-
lines.zh: 因为我最近在三人性交方面学了不少东西，而且我得说——

lines.en: : Okay, I’d like to shower in silence for the rest of the afternoon. Thanks.
lines.zh: 好了，今天下午剩下的时间我想安静地洗澡。谢谢。

lines.en: {i}One more day without you passes by.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}没有你的又一天过去了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The cogs continue to move.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}齿轮仍在转动。{/i}
